posts.title: aprs.fi for Android is here!
posts.description: For 10 years, every time a new version of the aprs.fi iPhone app came out, the first question was always the same: "when can we have it on Android?" For a long time I was pretty sure the answer would be "never" — but here we are! The aprs.fi app for Android is now available on the Google Play Store. posts.title: CG Antenna GW-1000 APRS iGate has serious bugs
posts.description: The CG Antenna GW-1000 APRS iGate gateway appliance contains faulty firmware which causes severe problems to APRS messaging worldwide. The IS -> RF gateway feature must be disabled on all GW-1000 devices until the bug is fixed by CG Antenna, and firmware is updated on the devices. Please contact the vendor for further instructions.
